facts.fact: On average each commercial airliner is struck by lightning about once a year.
facts.quote: on average, each airliner in commercial service is struck by lightning about once a year

facts.fact: Lightning current flows along the conductive outer skin and exits from an extremity such as the tail.
facts.quote: the current passes along the outer skin

facts.fact: Aircraft are designed and certified to withstand lightning strikes.

angle: A lightning strike is routine engineering, not a disaster.
